blocks.prompt: 4. The side of a cube is measured to be 30 cm with a maximum error of 0.14 cm in its measurement. Find the maximum error in the calculated volume of the cube.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh napne ki ghalti (measurement error) ka sawal hai, bilkul Example 28 jaisa.
Diya kya hai? Side \(x = 30\) cm, aur side napne mein zyada se zyada ghalti \(dx = \pm 0.14\) cm.
Find kya karna hai? Volume \(V = x^{3}\) mein maximum ghalti \(dV\).
Plan: \(dV = 3x^{2}\,dx\) nikal kar \(x = 30\) aur \(dx = \pm 0.14\) rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x = 30\) cm, \(dx = \pm 0.14\) cm.
Maloom karna: volume mein maximum ghalti \(dV\).
Tareeqa: \(V = x^{3}\), \(dV = 3x^{2}\,dx\) (Example 28 ki tarah). Side ki chhoti si ghalti ka volume par asar differential batata hai.

Volume ka differential
\[V = x^{3}\]
\[dV = 3x^{2}\,dx \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: \(x^{3}\) ka derivative \(3x^{2}\), aur differential ke liye \(dx\) se multiply.

\(x = 30\), \(dx = \pm 0.14\) rakhein
\[dV = 3(30)^{2}(\pm 0.14)\]
\[= 3(900)(\pm 0.14)\]
\[= \pm 378 \text{ cm}^{3}\]
Kyun: \(30^{2} = 900\), \(3 \times 900 = 2700\), aur \(2700 \times 0.14 = 378\). \(\pm\) is liye ke ghalti zyada ya kam dono taraf ho sakti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[V = 30^{3} = 27000 \text{ cm}^{3}\]
Asal tabdeeliyan: \(30.14^{3} - 30^{3} \approx 379.77\) aur \(30^{3} - 29.86^{3} \approx 376.24\). Hamara andaza 378 in dono ke beech hai. Percentage mein: \(\frac{378}{27000} \times 100 = 1.4\%\), jo side ke percentage error (\(\approx 0.47\%\)) ka 3 guna hai, jaisa power 3 ki wajah se hona chahiye.
